title_filter._comment: Applied to GDELT and RSS items only. ReliefWeb items are already filtered by its Mine Action theme.

gdelt._comment: Keyless. Phrases in double quotes, OR'd terms inside parentheses. Script waits 6 s between queries.
queries: (landmine OR landmines OR demining OR "mine clearance" OR "unexploded ordnance") sourcelang:english

reliefweb._comment: Needs repository secret RELIEFWEB_APPNAME (pre-approved). Skipped silently until it exists.

rss._comment: Add only feeds you have opened in a browser and confirmed are live RSS/Atom. Format: {"name": "...", "url": "..."}
